items.title: 2027 Is My Year Sunrise
items.alt: Coral 2027 Is My Year lettering framing a gold rising sun between two olive sprigs.
items.description: The arched year sits above the short personal message, with gold bevels following the rounded coral letters.

items.title: 2027 My Year to Shine Star
items.alt: Navy-and-gold 2027 My Year to Shine lettering across a large gold star with pink and teal star accents.
items.description: The oversized word Shine anchors the base beneath the smaller message and bold blue year.

items.title: Make It Happen in 2027 Arrow
items.alt: Make It Happen in 2027 lettering inside an upward arrow outline, with a small orange rocket at one side.
items.description: Cream and orange lettering stands against the navy inner shapes, while the rocket's curved flame follows the bottom of the year.

items.title: New Year New Possibilities 2027 Doorway
items.alt: Open lavender doors above gold-and-purple ribbons reading New Year New Possibilities 2027.
items.description: Golden light rays fill the doorway while the large year curves across a cream ribbon below the two-line message.

items.title: Blast Off into 2027 Rocket
items.alt: Red-and-blue toy rocket rising above 2027, beneath the words Blast Off into and beside a ringed blue planet.
items.description: A broad flame curves behind the year, linking the tilted rocket to the arched greeting.

items.title: Hello 2027 Rainbow and Clouds
items.alt: Multicolored Hello 2027 lettering beneath a bright rainbow with two smiling cloud characters.
items.description: One cloud winks while the other wears a pink bow, framing the rounded glossy greeting below the rainbow.
